Lina: Heads-up — SOC2 fieldwork tentatively scheduled Apr 6-8. Need to lock audit-window cadence and a clear owner-handover plan for KMS/HSM + auditlog ingestion. Proposal: staggered cutover slots to avoid team contention. Who can own the handover docs + runbook?

Aj: I can own the KMS handover doc. Will draft a runbook for cutover and PoP (proof-of-possession) verification. ETA Wed Mar 25. Will need a reviewer from sec + infra.

Tim: HSM attestation is the main blocker for us. Vendor availability for attestation is Apr 2-4. I can't be on Apr 3-4 though, so need someone to coordinate vendor windows and smoke-run in my absence.

Priya: I can coordinate vendor slots and HSM test cert setup. Also note: auditlog retention change triggers an ops-side DB migration (small schema + reindex) — estimate ~4h work, low risk.

deploy-bot: maintenance window created: 2026-04-01T02:00Z - 2026-04-01T06:00Z (tag: auditlog-migration). Notifying: @Priya.

Lina: Thanks — thinking staggered approach: Apr 1 auditlog migration, Apr 2 HSM attestation dry-run, Apr 6-8 fieldwork window. If that works, please add owners to the runbook and confirm dry-run attendees. I also need an attendee list for the external auditor.

Aj: Adding preliminary runbook skeleton now:
```
- pre-cutover checklist: backup snapshots, smoke tests, ingest throttles
- cutover steps: pause ingestion, rotate KEKs, validate consumer sigs, confirm KV caches
- post-cutover: re-enable batching, sanity-check traces/metrics, collect evidence bundle
- rollback: re-import previous KEK, rehydrate caches, verify consumer acceptance
```
I'll push a PR to the internal docs repo and request reviews from @Tim and @Priya.

Tim: I'll review the HSM-specific steps. Important: include explicit rollback for key rotation and a step to verify attestation signatures from the vendor. Also add vendor contact + cert thumbprint checks.

Priya: Ops note — staging DB migration dry-run scheduled Thu Mar 28 15:00-16:00 UTC. I'll invite Tim & Aj to observe. Staging downtime estimate: 30-45m.

Lina: Action items and owners:
- Aj: KMS runbook PR by Mar 25 (owner: Aj)
- Priya: staging dry-run invite by Mar 26 (owner: Priya)
- Tim: HSM rollback appendix by Mar 29 (owner: Tim)
I'll assemble attendee list and share with external auditor once runbook PR is up. Please react with :thumbsup: if dates look good.
